transposeRanges.basis: Source P10/P11 old horn bass clef at XML497–508; International Horn Society historical convention, independently reviewed by VerS.

bars.description: Source bars 1–188, then second-ending bar 191 through 513: exposition repeat omitted, including its two-bar first ending. Provisional order follows the recording’s contrasting development after the first exposition, not a duration-only guess.

endpoints.basis: Score-pitch energy-rise search windows; provisional automatic alignment, not listening annotations.

provenance: Original CC0 orchestral MusicXML retained byte-for-byte; only separately licensed analytical lyric nodes are omitted before conversion.

C-horn source parts P10/P11 use old bass-clef notation in XML measures497–508, canonical q1489.5–1525.5. That convention sounds one octave above the ordinary treble-clef transposition: apply+12 only to those spans, preserving engraving. E-flat horns are unchanged. Independent source review: International Horn Society, https://www.hornsociety.org/publications/horn-call/horn-call-archive/149-advice-for-amateurs . Other source transpositions remain active.
Custom MIDI score bypasses musicxml2ly articulate playback so durations describe written notation.
